objective.title: Keep HQ public-safe while standing up the first founder revenue sprint
success_criteria: README explains the public AI-first project clearly
tracked example docs are public-safe and reusable
Task Board.md is rendered from active-work.json
local and CI validation fail on blocked private paths, sensitive local artifacts, and obvious secrets
no tracked git history contains private runtime, customer data, personal data, or credentials
Founder Revenue Sprint has one selected wedge, one parked challenger, and explicit open dependencies in tracked truth
Deal Velocity Pilot packaging, trust pack, outreach prep, and cross-border route are active queue items
no tracked file contains raw prospect data, customer materials, or bulky research output from the private GPT pack

tasks.title: Install the machine-readable AI control plane and generated board
tasks.next_step: Use the control plane as the primary queue instead of treating it as architecture-only.
tasks.done_when: `05 AI Control Plane/` exists, validates, and `Task Board.md` is rendered from it.

tasks.title: Add telemetry, validation, and tests for the HQ runtime
tasks.next_step: Keep runtime data under `.hq/` and out of tracked history.
tasks.done_when: Validation passes, telemetry events can be written, and tests cover the runtime surfaces.

tasks.title: Replace the stage-1 AI COO role with AI Operations Lead and tighten Stage 2 operating contracts
tasks.next_step: Keep the public operating contract consistent across docs and prompts.
tasks.done_when: Operating docs, role prompts, control-plane contracts, and review contracts reference AI Operations Lead consistently.

tasks.title: Rewrite the README and example state for public GitHub readers
tasks.next_step: Keep example state public-safe as the project evolves.
tasks.done_when: README, planning docs, project docs, and notes explain the framework without exposing live private operations.

tasks.title: Add a publication-safety gate for blocked paths, sensitive local artifacts, and secrets
tasks.next_step: Keep the blocked-path rules and secret patterns aligned with real repository usage.
tasks.done_when: Local and CI validation fail if blocked private paths, sensitive local artifacts, or obvious secrets are tracked.

tasks.title: Stand up the founder revenue sprint from the GPT 5.4 Pro management pack
tasks.next_step: Package the Deal Velocity Pilot, build the minimum trust pack, and resolve the cross-border route before any serious external launch.
tasks.done_when: The winner, challenger, strategic rules, and open dependencies from the private pack are distilled into tracked HQ without copying raw research.

tasks.title: Package the human-reviewed Deal Velocity Pilot
tasks.next_step: Turn the selected wedge into a one-page offer with ICP, trigger event, scope, exclusions, first deliverable, price band, qualification questions, and proof gaps.
tasks.done_when: The Deal Velocity Pilot has a usable commercial memo for live conversations and a clear list of what is explicitly out of scope.

tasks.title: Build the minimum trust pack for early pilot sales
tasks.next_step: Define the minimum sendable package covering security overview, data handling, retention and deletion, NDA baseline, subprocessor posture, DPA position, and incident contact.
tasks.done_when: A serious prospect can review the trust pack without hand-waving about how sensitive materials will be handled.

tasks.title: Build the first target list and start founder-led discovery outreach
tasks.next_step: Choose the sharpest first B2B SaaS slice, build the first 20-50 target accounts, and draft outreach plus discovery prompts around live security-review bottlenecks.
tasks.done_when: The first target list exists, messaging is drafted, and the first batch of discovery conversations is ready to request.

tasks.title: Resolve the foreign-entity and invoicing route for US/EU pilot sales
tasks.next_step: Turn the current conclusion into a decision-ready brief covering jurisdiction shortlist, bank and processor sequence, counterparty design, blocked actions, and where human counsel is mandatory.
tasks.done_when: HQ has a decision-ready foreign-entity route with legal and tax questions explicit enough for human review before serious enterprise closing.
